method: Falsifiable calls about points/loyalty landscape movement — bonuses expected to return, devaluations expected to land, sweet spots expected to close. Each has a concrete test and a real horizon date. Misses recorded honestly.

calls.call: The current Chase Ultimate Rewards → IHG One Rewards 70% transfer bonus (expiring 2026-08-31) will NOT be extended or replaced with any Chase→IHG transfer bonus before 2026-10-31.
calls.basis: Chase already stepped this promo down once — from a 100% early-bird (Jul 15-30) to 70% (Jul 31-Aug 31). Stepping down mid-campaign is a cool-off signal, not a warm-up. Historically Chase has left 3-6 month gaps between IHG promos.
calls.test: GRADE HIT if no Chase→IHG transfer bonus of any percentage is publicly offered between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31. GRADE MISS if any Chase→IHG bonus (>0%) is announced or live during that window.
